dedupe_keys.name: sdwpf spatial dynamic wind power forecasting observations

description: The SDWPF research team publishes operating observations for a wind farm containing 134 turbines. The full release covers January 2020 to December 2021 and combines SCADA measurements with ERA5 weather context, timestamps, relative turbine positions and elevations. Identical full observations are supplied in CSV and Parquet, alongside the earlier 245-day KDD Cup subset and final challenge test archive. Figshare access is public and free under CC BY 4.0. The data can calibrate wind-power forecasts and test generation assumptions used in electricity simulations such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that the challenge subset omits information later restored in the full release, so benchmark splits and leakage controls matter. Relative coordinates do not establish absolute turbine locations. Reanalysis context relates to data-era5-reanalysis. No observation files or test archives were downloaded.
